name: terminal-matematico
description: Terminal matematico embarcado (ESP32-S3): simulador, backend e firmware

scripts.test: npm run test:sim && npm run test:backend && npm run test:firmware
scripts.test:firmware: cmake -S tests/firmware -B build/host-tests -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug && cmake --build build/host-tests -j && ctest --test-dir build/host-tests --output-on-failure
